notes: Master total 199 as printed in the PokeCottage PDF header ('199 cards (plus promos and variants)'). Master composition (no reverse holos in this set — every card is printed holo): 128 main-set cards + 33 secret rares (129-158 plus the 3 RGB Mew, R/G/B) + 30 Classic Collection cards + 8 Basic Energies (MEE 009-016). That is the only decomposition that reaches 199; the 7 reverse-holo rows in the PDF's Variants section are grand-master-only. Grand master total 292 is derived, not printed: master 199 + 49 promos + 40 variants + 4 stamped-energy variants listed in the PDF's Grand Master Set section. Card names/rarities cross-checked against TCGdex (api.pokemontcg.io returned 502/500 on 2026-11-26). TCGdex lists the RGB Mew as R/G/B with rarity 'RGB Rare'. All main-set and secret-rare cards carry variant 'Holo' (the whole set is printed holofoil; TCGdex records no reverse-holo printing for any card in the set). Classic Collection images are null: TCGdex has no image for these cards and no verified scrydex image ID was found for the Classic Collection (candidates 30ccc/cel30c/me55c all serve the placeholder). The cards are reprints of older cards (original set numbers on mastersets.com/pokemon/30ccc), so original-printing art is the fallback if images are filled in later. Classic rarity is null — TCGdex records no rarity for these cards and PokeCottage prints none. tcgApiSetId 'me55' is the image-host ID (scrydex me55-<n> images verified as real card art, not the placeholder); the Pokemon TCG API set lookup for me55 returned 502 on 2026-11-26 so the API ID itself is not independently confirmed. setCode '30TH' follows the TCGdex set ID. Promo rarity is recorded as 'Promo'. Variant entries carry rarity null (their base cards come from many different sets, so no single rarity applies). Stamped-energy variants use the printed MEE number and the stamped description; their images are null. v1.0.2 (Nov 26, 2026): Master Set redefined per Jeremy — one of each card number (incl. secret rares); holo / reverse-holo / stamp variations are Grand Master only. Master 199 -> 199; Grand unchanged at 292.
